Word is Gaoh's evil Grand Bandit Gang is rampaging in Ultra Cube. Go stop them.
Hey, Gaoh!! Where are ya!! Get out here!!
What the hell are you doing!! Why would you tell him where we are yourself!!
Daah, shut up!! Gaoh! Get out here!!
Who's there? Who's calling my name?
I wondered who it was. So it's you, Den-O.
Yo, Gaoh! Looks like you've been raisin' hell around here!
Well, I came all the way here to take ya down!
...What are you talking about? Are you an idiot?
Whaddya say!? Why, you...
Is that all you've got?
Whoa!!
That's enough. Get out of here, now.
Like I'd ever listen to anything you say!
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not asking.
Daah!
Listen. I'll say this just once more. Get out of my sight.
Ngh! He's strong!
Sempai, you okay?
What, Turtle!? I'm in the middle of a fight!! Don't talk to me!
That won't cut it, Sempai. Scoot over a sec.
What're you doin', Turtle!!
I figured you couldn't win, Sempai. Hey you, how about you let me reel you in?
Hold it right there!! Leave this one to me!
Hey, Kin-chan!
I can't leave this to you lot. Leave it to me.
No fair, Bear! Let me have a go too!
I'm gonna beat you, okay? I don't care about your answer!
Ryuta!! Don't you go jumpin' in on your own...
But everyone looks like they're having so much fun. Of course I'm joining in too♪
You snot-nosed brat! This ain't playtime!
You bastards!! Is this some cute little playtime for the four of you!!
Huh?
Den-O can now use a new skill.
Oh!? What's this!?
No way... Sempai, looks like we've turned into Climax Form.
Climax Form, ya say?
What? What the hell is going on?
Perfect timing!! I'll take ya on with this!
Let's go, you guys!! From here on out, it's our climax!!

report: 80/80 rows examined. Quest012.bla and Quest013.bla both map TextIdOffset+N -> row N+1. DG_QUEST012 tail: Ahead 121, Ankh 123, 00 124/144, system 159-162; leader blocks 107-120, 125-138, 145-158 and rows 140/143 unreferenced (speakers inferred). DG_QUEST013: Gaoh vs Momotaros, then Urataros/Kintaros/Ryutaros take over and Climax Form unlocks; row 32 (Gaoh) unreferenced but certain from context. 0.143 speaker not recovered. No new names; Gaoh, Climax Form, Grand Bandit Gang reuse existing terms.
